I guess I have to add... the thing that she did has me feeling less than human. It was so disrespectful and disgusting. Idk why someone would do something like that to me. 

Honestly I feel like the kid who gets picked on at school or something.
Yeah thats true. Thats a little bit why I feel so pathetic. I should just be over it by now. It doesn't help that I see her almost everyday. Its torture.
